entities.name: Bant
entities.description: A shard whose landscape and ruins are known to its defenders as a weapon against invaders.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A planeswalker who speaks of Bant's landscape and ruins as a weapon the invaders can't comprehend.

entities.name: Ancestral Mask
entities.description: Masks grown from ancient trees that lend strength to the dryads.

entities.name: the collision of the shards
entities.description: The collision of the shards, during which entire ways of life disappeared without a trace.

events.summary: During the collision of the shards, entire ways of life disappear without a trace.
events.quote: During the collision of the shards, entire ways of life disappeared without a trace.

relations.note: Elspeth speaks of knowledge of Bant's landscape as a weapon against invaders.
relations.quote: "Knowledge of Bant's landscape and ruins is a weapon that the invaders can't comprehend." —Elspeth
